description.value:
Frequency once per day

Cost 1 Grace or Cinder

A middle-tier personal-scale effect usable without spending your full banked resource.

Produce an effect between a Lesser and a Greater Miracle in scale, affecting one creature or one object at personal scale — never a building, a crowd, or a region. Work the specific effect out with the GM using §4's Lesser column as the floor and its Greater column as the ceiling. This spends 1 point rather than your full banked resource.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3: the Grace/Cinder spend half is mechanically simple once the pool exists, but 'spend N' isn't itself expressed by a rule element (it's a manual actor update, same as gain); the produced effect between Lesser and Greater Miracle is pure GM narrative.
